subject: general
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between man, smokers and cricketers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e97ab273ecefd1ae34102244a5e59539af0bd98ac78fb52d01b925a64a6c92b.png]
solution:
The relationship between man, smokers, and cricketers is as follows:

i) Some man are smokers.

ii) Some man are cricketers.

iii) Some smokers are cricketers.

The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a5fcfdb4bd63a6cf8d48e734a3d5b858c338605f03cb2ee40c06426462c34c4.png] 

Hence, **figure 'C' **is the correct answer.
